sections.ingredients:
Kutaj (Holarrhena antidysenterica) 
 Ativisha (Aconitum heterophyllum) 

 Method of Preparation 
 Boil Kutaj in 16 times water till just 1/8th part is remaining. Remove the decoction from the flame and and let it cool down and filter it through a muslin cloth. Cook it for some more time till it thickens. Let it dry under sunlight and add Ativisha powder. Make 175 mg tablets each and put it in the dryer till all the moisture has evaporated. Store it in an airtight container. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Kutaj ghan vati is an ayurvedic medicine available in tablet form. It is meant to manage the various digestive disorders. Natural ingredients used in the formulation of this medicine are packed with antimicrobial properties. In diarrhea and dysentery use of this medicine is quite effective as it helps to extrude the microorganism from the body. These tablets also help to manage the symptoms like abdominal pain, fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, watery diarrhea with mucus or pus etc. It is quite a good remedy to manage the problem of loose stools in fever. Use of this medicine is quite good in malabsorption syndrome as it accelerates the absorption of nutrients in body and helps to fulfill the nutritional deficiencies in the body. Besides of all this, calmative and cooling action of this medicine helps to manage the rectal bleeding in ulcerative colitis.

Kutaj Ghan Vati – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Siddha Yoga Sangraha, Atisara Pravahika Grahani Rogadhikara 
 Introduction 
 Kutaj Ghan Vati is an herbal formulation, in tablet from. It is useful in curing diarrhea, dysentery, intestinal infections and bleeding disorders etc. These tablets also provide relief in irritable bowel syndrome. Kutaj Ghan Vati has antidysenteric, antidiarrheal, anti-amoebic action and hemostatic properties. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Kutaj (Holarrhena antidysenterica) 
 Ativisha (Aconitum heterophyllum) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Boil Kutaj in 16 times water till just 1/8th part is remaining. Remove the decoction from the flame and and let it cool down and filter it through a muslin cloth. Cook it for some more time till it thickens. Let it dry under sunlight and add Ativisha powder. Make 175 mg tablets each and put it in the dryer till all the moisture has evaporated. Store it in an airtight container. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Kutaj ghan vati is an ayurvedic medicine available in tablet form. It is meant to manage the various digestive disorders. Natural ingredients used in the formulation of this medicine are packed with antimicrobial properties. In diarrhea and dysentery use of this medicine is quite effective as it helps to extrude the microorganism from the body. These tablets also help to manage the symptoms like abdominal pain, fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, watery diarrhea with mucus or pus etc. It is quite a good remedy to manage the problem of loose stools in fever. Use of this medicine is quite good in malabsorption syndrome as it accelerates the absorption of nutrients in body and helps to fulfill the nutritional deficiencies in the body. Besides of all this, calmative and cooling action of this medicine helps to manage the rectal bleeding in ulcerative colitis. 
 Indications 
 
 Diarrhea 
 Dysentery 
 Malabsorption syndrome 
 Loose stools due to fever 
 Ulcerative colitis 
 
 Classical Reference 
 
 Dosage 
 2 to 3 tablets thrice a day with plain water after meals. 
 Contraindications 
 
 There are no reported side effects of this medicine. 
 Over dosage should be strictly avoided. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
